findings.text: the production count credits this node with two names its own record attributes to another agent: sib-vocab-gap-requeue.html:94-96 states that a peer run composed two of the 17 to attached with a produced name, transition.json records after_status_counts {attached: 2, extracted: 15} with both dd:nbi/unit/beamlets_group/beamlets/tangency_radii and dd:summary/heating_current_drive/nbi/tangency_radius/value attached to tangency_radius_of_neutral_beam_injector while every other cohort source read extracted, and the pipeline's own summary at run.log:1739-1742 reports names_composed 2 and names_enriched 2, four names in all - so this node produced 4 names and 2 accepted scores, not 6 and 4; the headline the plan will quote overstates this node's output by a third, and every raw number needed to correct it is on disk

the sentence stating all 17 of this node's sources stood at vocab_gap before the rerun reports the sibling run's leaving status, not the pre-rerun state: the counter is built from transition receipts whose before_status is read from the sibling readback at sib-vocab-gap-requeue-run.py:264, while the node's own transition.json records 15 sources at extracted and 2 at attached when it observed state, so a reader takes a pre-state the node's own receipt contradicts and the outcome table's status-before column is never identified as the cohort baseline
